description: Use when the user gives a vanity name or a steamcommunity.com/id/ link and the steamid64 behind it is needed, or when a resolved identity is needed in every format without profile data: steamid64, SteamID (STEAM_1:0:x), SteamID3 ([U:1:x]), steam hex, vanity, profile URL. Resolution goes through Steam; unresolvable ids return an error result - never a partial guess. Do not use for pure format conversion of a known id (steam_convert is cheaper) or for profile data (steam_profile).

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_identity

vanity.description: custom URL name when known, otherwise null

title: SteamID resolver
